correctness.rationale: For proper S in C_n, each induced component is a path with perfect matching iff its maximal one-run has even positive length. Every omitted gap of length <=3 is disjunctively dominated, and gap >=4 has a second unserved zero. Rooting at one of s selected-run starts yields exactly n/s times the positive composition coefficients. Independent exact enumerations of all labeled vertex subsets for n=3..14 using generic shortest-path domination and recursive perfect-matching tests matched every full polynomial coefficient. Formal logarithmic cycle construction then yields the claimed rational generating function. The deficit d=5k−n and s=k or k−1 gives the five-residue min-set formulas, and unique simple positive pole rho yields total P_n(1)~rho^(−n) with unit coefficient. Finite tests support but do not prove all n.
